item.title: White House's new Iran hype video lights up the internet
item.description: The White House drew widespread outrage Thursday after posting a hype video glorifying Iran strikes, captioned "JUSTICE THE AMERICAN WAY" on X. The montage intersperses military footage with clips from popular action movies and television shows. The release came as the New York Times published an investigation revealing the U.S. bombed a girls' school in Iran, killing 175 civilians. item.title: Hegseth triggers massive alarms with 'grotesque' Iran remark in new '60 Minutes' clip
item.description: Critics on social media sounded the alarm after comments from Pete Hegseth in a preview of an upcoming interview on “60 Minutes” began circulating online Friday.In the clip, Hegseth was asked about reports that Russia is assisting Iran in targeting Americans and whether that would place U.S. personnel in greater danger.“No one’s putting us in danger,” Hegseth replied in the interview, set to air Sunday. “We’re putting the other guys in danger. That’s our job. So we’re not concerned about that.”

item.title: GOP revolt grows: Republicans plot payback against Bondi for Epstein files mess
